name: 鄭辰仰
objective:
介紹 VBA 語言基本資料處理的概念，包含基本輸入與輸出、程式的流程控制、函數的應用等指令之撰寫、程式之編輯、編譯、聯絡與程式之執行，並發展一套應用程式。
This course introduces the basic data processes of EXCEL VBA language. They include input/output, program process control, application of functions, program editing and execution, and so on.
schedule:
1. Getting started with Excel VBA programming
2. Programming concepts
3. Communicating with your users
4. Putting it all together
scorePolicy:
Midterm Exam 40%
Final Exam 40%
Excel VBA Application Project 20%
materials:

remarks: This course is conducted in English. Students will learn Excel VBA through lectures, demonstrations, hands-on exercises, and application projects. Generative AI tools may be used to support programming, debugging, and problem solving; however, students are expected to understand, verify, and explain the VBA code used in their assignments and projects.
